n: 30 In. 4.0 Cu. Ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range With 4 Burner Gas Cooktop And Electric Convection Oven In Stainless Steel With Satin Stainless Steel Door
desc: Luxury isn’t meant to be left desired—it’s meant to be attainable. The ZLINE 30 in. 4.0 cu. ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range with 4 Burner Gas Cooktop and Electric Convection Oven in Stainless Steel with Satin Stainless Steel Door (RA-SN-30) pairs a powerful gas cooktop with 4 Italian-crafted burners, an electric convection oven, and a beautiful Satin stainless steel door with a Landscape oven door window design.
hl: The Legacy Professional Range Series represents the foundation for ZLINE’s family-focused mission of attainable luxury
Outfit your ZLINE Legacy Dual Fuel Range with a beautiful Satin Stainless Steel oven door
Optimize every meal with even heat distribution thanks to high-performance technology of a gas cooktop and an electric convection oven
Industry-leading gas cooktop includes 4 hand-cast burners with 1,000 - 18,000 BTUs of cooking power
ZLINE Legacy Series ranges feature a sleek Landscape oven door design that provides ample viewing space to ensure your dishes are perfectly cooked
A 4.0 cu. ft oven fits pans up to 23 in. wide for maximum space and convenience with everyday cooking
